ToggleZoom.title: Set Zoom
ToggleZoom.description: Zoom magnifies the entire screen. Zoom can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleVoiceOver.title: Set VoiceOver
ToggleVoiceOver.description: VoiceOver speaks items on the screen. VoiceOver can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

StartSpeakScreen.title: Start Speak Screen
StartSpeakScreen.description: Speak Screen allows you to hear the content of the screen. Speak Screen can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

StartMagnifier.title: Open Magnifier
StartMagnifier.description: Magnifier lets you use your device’s camera to magnify your surroundings. Magnifier can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleVoiceControl.title: Set Voice Control
ToggleVoiceControl.description: Voice Control allows you to use your voice to control your iOS device. Voice Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleSwitchControl.title: Set Switch Control
ToggleSwitchControl.description: Switch Control highlights items on the screen to control through an adaptive accessory. Switch Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

StartGuidedAccess.title: Start Guided Access
StartGuidedAccess.description: Guided Access keeps your iOS device in a single app. Set up Guided Access under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleAssistiveTouch.title: Set AssistiveTouch
ToggleAssistiveTouch.description: AssistiveTouch allows you to use your device if you have difficulty touching the screen or if you require an adaptive accessory. AssistiveTouch can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleSmartInvert.title: Set Smart Invert
ToggleSmartInvert.description: Reverses the colors of the display except for images, media and some apps that use dark color styles. Smart Invert can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleClassicInvert.title: Set Classic Invert
ToggleClassicInvert.description: Reverses the colors of the display. Classic Invert can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleTransparency.title: Set Reduce Transparency
ToggleTransparency.description: Improve contrast by reducing transparency and blurs on some backgrounds to increase legibility. Reduce Transparency can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleContrast.title: Set Increase Contrast
ToggleContrast.description: Increase color contrast between app foreground and background colors. Increase Contrast can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleWhitePoint.title: Set White Point
ToggleWhitePoint.description: Reduce White Point lowers the intensity of bright colors. Reduce White Point can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleMonoAudio.title: Set Mono Audio
ToggleMonoAudio.description: Mono Audio enables the left and right speakers to play the same content. Mono Audio can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleLEDFlash.title: Set LED Flash
ToggleLEDFlash.description: LED flashes for alerts. LED Flash can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleAudioDescriptions.title: Set Audio Descriptions
ToggleAudioDescriptions.description: Automatically play audio descriptions. Audio Descriptions can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleCaptions.title: Set Closed Captions+SDH
ToggleCaptions.description: Use closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing. Closed captions can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SetLargeText.title: Set Text Size
SetLargeText.description: Customize your text size with extended accessibility sizes. Large Text can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleReduceMotion.title: Set Reduce Motion
ToggleReduceMotion.description: Reduce the motion of the user interface, including the parallax effect of icons. Reduce Motion can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleSoundDetection.title: Set Sound Recognition
ToggleSoundDetection.description: Sound Recognition will continuously listen for certain sounds, and using on-device intelligence, will notify you when sounds may be recognized. Sound Recognition can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SetSoundDetector.title: Set Recognized Sound
SetSoundDetector.description: Select which sound you’d like to be detected when Sound Recognition is enabled. When this sound is recognized, you will receive a notification. Recognized Sounds can be configured at any time under Accessibility in Settings.

SetBackgroundSound.title: Change Background Sound
SetBackgroundSound.description: Change the background sound that will play when background sounds is turned on. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SetBackgroundSoundVolume.title: Set Background Sounds Volume
SetBackgroundSoundVolume.description: Sets the volume for background sounds. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise and can be used when media is playing. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleBackgroundSoundsTimer.title: Set Background Sounds Timer
ToggleBackgroundSoundsTimer.description: Turn the background sounds timer on or off. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise and can be used when media is playing. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SetBackgroundSoundTimer.title: Set Background Sounds Timer Interval
SetBackgroundSoundTimer.description: Sets the timer interval for background sounds. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise and can be used when media is playing. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

ToggleColorFilters.title: Set Color Filters
ToggleColorFilters.description: Enable or disable Color Filters, allowing the display's colors to be adjusted as desired.

StartRemoteWatchScreen.title: Start Apple Watch Remote Screen
StartRemoteWatchScreen.description: Fully control Apple Watch from iPhone and use Switch Control, Voice Control, or any other assistive features on iPhone to get the most out of your Apple Watch.

ToggleAutoAnswerCalls.title: Auto-Answer Calls
ToggleAutoAnswerCalls.description: Toggle whether calls are automatically answered

SetLeftRightBalance.title: Set Left/Right Balance
SetLeftRightBalance.description: Left/Right Balance can be used to adjust the audio volume balance between left and right channels. -1.0 represents full Left balance and 1.0 represents full Right balance. Left/Right Balance can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SetSwitchControlSwitch.title: Set Switch Control Switch State
SetSwitchControlSwitch.description: Enable, disable, and/or toggle the state of any Switches that have been set up for Switch Control. Switches can be added in Settings > Accessibility > Switch Control.

ToggleNameRecognition.title: Toggle Name Recognition
ToggleNameRecognition.description: Name Recognition will continuously listen for certain names, and using on-device intelligence, will notify you when a name may be recognized. Name Recognition can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SplitText.title: Split Text
SplitText.description: Separates text passed into the action into a list.

CombineText.title: Combine Text
CombineText.description: Joins the text together, inserting the separator between each join.

ChangeCase.title: Change Case
ChangeCase.description: Changes the case of the text passed into the action to UPPERCASE, lowercase, or Title Case.

CorrectSpelling.title: Correct Spelling
CorrectSpelling.description: Autocorrects the spelling of text passed into the action.

MatchText.title: Match Text
MatchText.description: Searches text passed into the action for matches to a regular expression.

MatchTextGetGroup.title: Get Group from Matched Text
MatchTextGetGroup.description: Gets the text that matched a particular capture group or all of the capture groups from the output of a Match Text action.

AskForInput.title: Ask for Input
AskForInput.description: Prompts the user to enter a piece of information.

ChooseFromList.title: Choose from List
ChooseFromList.description: Presents a menu of the items passed as input to the action and outputs the user's selection.

SetAirplaneMode.title: Set Airplane Mode
SetAirplaneMode.description: Sets the device’s Airplane Mode to on or off.

SetWiFi.title: Set Wi-Fi
SetWiFi.description: Sets the device’s Wi-Fi to on or off.

SetBluetooth.title: Set Bluetooth
SetBluetooth.description: Sets the device’s Bluetooth to on or off.

SetCellularData.title: Set Cellular Data
SetCellularData.description: Sets the device’s Cellular Data to on or off.

SetLowPowerMode.title: Set Low Power Mode
SetLowPowerMode.description: Sets the device’s Low Power Mode to on or off.

SetFlashlight.title: Set Flashlight
SetFlashlight.description: Turns on or off the flashlight near the device's camera.

DeletePhotos.title: Delete Photos
DeletePhotos.description: Deletes the photos passed as input from the device's photo library. This action asks for confirmation before performing the deletion.

SetOrientationLock.title: Set Orientation Lock
SetOrientationLock.description: Turns on or off orientation lock on your device.

SetPersonalHotspot.title: Set Personal Hotspot
SetPersonalHotspot.description: Sets the device’s Personal Hotspot to on or off.

SetSilenceUnknownCallers.title: Set Silence Unknown Callers
SetSilenceUnknownCallers.description: Sets Silence Unknown Callers to on or off. When on, calls from unknown numbers will be silenced and sent to voicemail. Calls will still be displayed on the Recents list. Incoming calls will continue to ring from people in your contacts, recent outgoing calls, and Siri Suggestions.

SetNightShift.title: Set Night Shift
SetNightShift.description: Enables or disables Night Shift. When enabled, the colors of your display will be shifted to the warmer end of the color spectrum after dark. This may help you get a better night’s sleep.

SetTrueTone.title: Set True Tone
SetTrueTone.description: Enables or disables True Tone. When enabled, your device display will automatically adapt based on ambient lighting conditions to make colors appear consistent in different environments.

SetAnnounceNotifications.title: Set Announce Notifications
SetAnnounceNotifications.description: Sets Announce Notifications to on or off. When on, Siri will announce notifications from new apps that send Time Sensitive notifications or direct messages.

SetStageManager.title: Set Stage Manager
SetStageManager.description: Enables or disables Stage Manager on the device.

SetAlwaysOnDisplay.title: Set Always On Display
SetAlwaysOnDisplay.description: Sets the Always On Display setting on your iPhone to on or off.

EKUICalendars.title: Calendars
EKUICalendars.description: Shows upcoming events from the specified calendars.

NextEventComplicationConfiguration.title: Calendars
NextEventComplicationConfiguration.description: Shows upcoming events from the specified calendars.

MTCreateAlarm.description: Creates an alarm in the Clock app.

ToggleAlarm.description: Enables or disables an alarm in the Clock app.

GetAlarms.description: Gets all the alarms in the Clock app.

Clocks.description: View the time in multiple cities around the world.

ClocksSingle.title: City
ClocksSingle.description: Add a clock for a city to check the time at that location.

GetContact.title: GetContact
GetContact.description: Returns contact matching user-provided search terms

GetContactAttribute.title: GetContactAttribute
GetContactAttribute.description: Return contact attribute of a contact matching user-provided search terms

ModifyContactAttribute.title: ModifyContactAttribute
ModifyContactAttribute.description: Add, change, or delete MeCard nickname or relationship

LearnPronunciation.title: LearnPronunciation
LearnPronunciation.description: Add pronunciation of user or contact full name

GetSuggestions.title: Get Suggestions
GetSuggestions.description: Request for suggestions of contextual actions.

ExecuteSuggestion.title: Execute Suggestion
ExecuteSuggestion.description: User executes a suggestion by selecting (or tapping) it.

TranslatePhrase.title: Translate Phrase
TranslatePhrase.description: Used to represent user's intent to translate a phrase into some language

ToggleHeadPointer.title: Set Head Pointer
ToggleHeadPointer.description: Enable or disable Head Pointer, allowing movement of the mouse cursor using your head.

ToggleAlternatePointerActions.title: Set Alternate Pointer Actions
ToggleAlternatePointerActions.description: Enable or disable Alternate Pointer Actions, allowing the use of switches or gesture to trigger mouse actions such as clicks.

ToggleMouseKeys.title: Set Mouse Keys
ToggleMouseKeys.description: Enable or disable Mouse Keys, allowing the movement of the mouse cursor using the keyboard.

ToggleSlowKeys.title: Set Slow Keys
ToggleSlowKeys.description: Enable or disable Slow Keys, allowing the keyboard to avoid recognizing rapid key presses.

ToggleStickyKeys.title: Set Sticky Keys
ToggleStickyKeys.description: Enable or disable Sticky Keys, making it easier to press keyboard modifier keys.

ToggleAccessibilityKeyboard.title: Set Accessibility Keyboard
ToggleAccessibilityKeyboard.description: Enable or disable the Accessibility Keyboard, allowing typing by clicking on the screen.

ToggleFullKeyboardAccess.title: Set Full Keyboard Access
ToggleFullKeyboardAccess.description: Enable or disable Full Keyboard Access, allowing use of the device with only a keyboard.

SetBackgroundSoundsVolume.title: Set Background Sounds Volume
SetBackgroundSoundsVolume.description: Sets the volume for background sounds.

SetBackgroundSoundsTimer.title: Set Background Sounds Timer Interval
SetBackgroundSoundsTimer.description: Sets the timer interval for background sounds. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise and can be used when media is playing. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

SmartPrompt.title: Smart Prompt
SmartPrompt.description: Presents a smart prompt to authorize or deny a Shortcuts privacy permission.

SensitiveSmartPrompt.title: Sensitive Smart Prompt
SensitiveSmartPrompt.description: Presents a smart prompt to authorize or deny a Shortcuts privacy permission.

SetAlwaysOn.title: Set Always On
SetAlwaysOn.description:
Sets the Always On display setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Always On is activated, your Apple Watch face will be visible even when your wrist is down.

SetWaterLock.title: Set Water Lock
SetWaterLock.description:
Sets the Water Lock setting on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Water Lock protects against accidental input when you use your Apple Watch in water.

SetTheaterMode.title: Set Theater Mode
SetTheaterMode.description:
Sets Theater Mode on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Theater Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds and limits display activity.

PingMyPhone.title: Ping My iPhone
PingMyPhone.description:
Plays a sound on your paired iPhone.

You can also choose to have the flashlight pulse.

SetSilentMode.title: Set Silent Mode
SetSilentMode.description:
Sets Silent Mode on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Silent Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds.

SetWakeOnWristRaise.title: Set Wake on Wrist Raise
SetWakeOnWristRaise.description:
Sets the Wake on Wrist Raise setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Wake on Wrist Raise is on, the screen will wake when you raise your wrist.

SetAutoLaunchAudioApps.title: Set Auto-launch Audio Apps
SetAutoLaunchAudioApps.description:
Sets the Auto-launch Audio Apps setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Auto-launch Audio Apps is on, the app actively playing media will be shown when your Apple Watch wakes.

SetSchoolTime.title: Set Schooltime
SetSchoolTime.description:
Sets Schooltime on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Schooltime limits Apple Watch features during school hours.
